field_docs.id: Unique Mod identifier matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ and the directory name inside mods/.
field_docs.name: Human-readable display name shown in the Mod catalog.
field_docs.author: Maintainer or organization name.
field_docs.description: Concise summary of the Mod's capabilities.
field_docs.platforms: Supported host operating systems: subset of [windows, macos, linux].
field_docs.permissions: Minimal declared host permissions: subset of [vault_storage, profiles_read, profiles_write, browser_cdp, proxy_http].
field_docs.min_nebula_version: Minimum required Aether Nebula desktop version.
field_docs.download_url: HTTPS URL to the packaged nebula-mod-<id>-v<version>.zip release asset.
field_docs.sha256: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 checksum generated by scripts/package_mods.py (empty string permitted for bundled official Mods prior to tag release).
field_docs.homepage: Source repository or documentation URL for auditing the Mod.
